sample_size.notes: Uniquely balanced sample (50/50 bull/bear). Forms after a downtrend; bullish reversal signal on breakout.

target_calculation.description: Target = highest peak + (highest peak - lowest valley). Project upward from breakout above the highest peak.

ultimate_high_method.definition: Highest price after upward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to rise 5% above the highest peak after breakout.

failure_rate.notes: Only break-even (5%) value extracted from PDF review; full curve not captured. Reproducer should query chapter 48 for 10%/15%/20%.

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Median ~110 days. Slower than three falling peaks (35d) — bullish reversals take longer.

performance_statistics.best_market: bull (41% rise, 5% BE failure — strong bullish reversal, HIGH avg rise)
performance_statistics.comparison_vs_three_falling_peaks: Slower (110d vs 35d), larger avg move in bull market (41% vs 17%).

notes: PDF source: Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns (2nd ed.), chapter 48, p721-740.
